<!-- Generated by scripts/cli-reference.sh from "mandal help"; do not edit by hand. -->

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `app:backup` | Archive an app's files (--name=) to --destination=local, remote or all |
| `app:backup-configure` | Set an app's backup destinations and excludes from --from=&lt;file&gt; (--name=) |
| `app:backup-delete` | Delete one app archive (--name= --file= --where=local or remote) |
| `app:backup-get` | Write one app archive to stdout (--name= --file=) |
| `app:backup-list` | Show an app's backup settings, last run and archives as JSON (--name=) |
| `app:backup-tree` | List an app's backup root two levels deep with sizes as JSON (--name=) |
| `app:compose` | Print a Docker app's compose file, or replace it with --from=&lt;file&gt; |
| `app:configure` | Change an app's repository, branch, releases to keep, or a Docker app's proxied port |
| `app:control` | Start, stop or restart a Docker app (--name= --action=start/stop/restart) |
| `app:create` | Create a Laravel app (user, pool, site, database) |
| `app:delete` | Remove an app and everything mandal created for it |
| `app:deploy` | Deploy an app from its repository (zero downtime) |
| `app:deploy-script` | Print an app's deploy.sh, replace it with --from=&lt;file&gt;, or --reset it to the default |
| `app:env` | Print an app's .env, or replace it with --from=&lt;file&gt; |
| `app:list` | List apps and their manifests as JSON |
| `app:releases` | List an app's releases as JSON |
| `app:rollback` | Switch an app back to an earlier release |
| `app:ssl` | Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for an app |
| `backup:configure` | Set database backup destinations from --from=&lt;file&gt;, or write the --defaults once |
| `backup:delete` | Delete one database backup (--database= --file= --where=local or remote) |
| `backup:list` | List local and remote database backups as JSON |
| `backup:remote` | Add or update an S3-compatible remote from --from=&lt;file&gt; (--name=), or --remove it |
| `backup:remote-list` | List the remotes and which backups use them as JSON |
| `backup:restore` | Restore a backup into a new database (--database= --file=) |
| `backup:run` | Back up every database (or one with --database=) to --destination=local, remote or all |
| `backup:status` | Show the backup configuration and last runs as JSON |
| `cli:update` | Install a new version of the CLI from a tar.gz (--from=&lt;file&gt;) |
| `component:update` | Update a standalone component (--component=cache/js/composer/docker) |
| `db:access` | Set which users can use a database (--name=, --user= for each) |
| `db:create` | Create a database (--name=, optionally --user= for each user given access) |
| `db:delete` | Delete a database no app uses (--name=) |
| `db:list` | Databases with their size and users with their access, as JSON |
| `db:user:create` | Create a database user (--name=, --database= for each, password in --from=) |
| `db:user:delete` | Delete a database user no app uses (--name=) |
| `db:user:update` | Set a user's databases (--database= for each) and optionally its password (--from=) |
| `firewall:allow` | Allow a port (--port=443 [--proto=tcp/udp] [--from=&lt;cidr&gt;] [--comment=...]) |
| `firewall:delete` | Delete a rule by its number from firewall:list (--number=N) |
| `firewall:list` | List ufw rules as JSON |
| `inventory` | Show everything on this server as JSON |
| `key:add` | Allow another panel's public key (--key='ssh-ed25519 ...' --name=&lt;label&gt;) |
| `key:list` | List the panels' SSH keys as JSON |
| `key:remove` | Remove a panel's key by its fingerprint (--fingerprint=SHA256:...) |
| `logs:read` | Read a log source as JSON (--source=&lt;id&gt; [--lines=] [--grep=] [--since=] [--level=] [--after=]) |
| `logs:sources` | List readable log sources as JSON (--app=&lt;name&gt; to filter) |
| `panel:install` | Create an app for hosting the panel on this server (--name= --domain= --repo=) |
| `panel:update` | Update the hosted panel and the CLI to a release (--version=&lt;tag&gt;, default: the latest) |
| `php:available` | PHP versions the package source offers, as JSON |
| `php:default` | Make a version the CLI default (--version=8.4) |
| `php:install` | Install a PHP version with every extension Laravel needs (--version=8.4) |
| `php:list` | Installed PHP versions, the CLI default and which apps use each, as JSON |
| `php:remove` | Remove a PHP version no app uses (--version=8.3) |
| `provision` | Provision the server, or inspect it first with --check |
| `reboot` | Reboot the server after a short delay |
| `updates:apply` | Install updates (--security, --all or --package=&lt;name&gt;) |
| `updates:status` | Pending updates, component versions and reboot state as JSON |
| `version` | Print the installed mandal version |
| `worker:add` | Add a Supervisor program running an artisan command for an app |
| `worker:list` | List an app's Supervisor programs as JSON |
| `worker:remove` | Remove an app's Supervisor program |
| `worker:restart` | Restart an app's Supervisor programs |
